name: spec-driven-development
description: Spec-Driven Development (SDD) — a structured, specification-first workflow for planning and executing software features. Covers five phases: initialize, specify, plan, task, and execute. Includes Graphify integration for knowledge-graph-aware codebase navigation.

interface.shortDescription: Spec-first planning & execution workflow from Codex
interface.longDescription: Guides you through initialize → specify → plan → task → execute with progress tracking, checkpoints, and optional Graphify knowledge-graph navigation.
defaultPrompt: Set up SDD for this project.
Create a spec for a new feature.
Plan this feature, then break it into tasks.
Start a sprint with these features.
